source: Drone 1 as the 2026-11-15 bursts flew it: airframe_2026-11-12_raised.json with the bands off (left_band and right_band 0, since about 06:20 UTC; fly it with no tilt offset) and the large-signal terms the three bursts fit jointly (sw/sim/burst_replay.py: 05:29 burst90 with the bands, 07:03 burst60 and 07:13 burst30 without; the plant driven open loop by each log's throttles and servos on the 2026-11-14 stand's thrust table, body rates and attitude reset to the log's every 0.05 s, all three axes): the tilt's pitch authority 2.3x the geometry's (tilt_authority; 1.9-2.4 window by window, pitch alone), the servos 40 ms late (0.043 / 0.04 before) with wn 31 (the bands-off bursts' 31, 24.7 with the 05:29 one; the hold needs 31 or more on this authority to shake as the drone did rather than diverge), the assemblies' swing reaction at about the CAD's (servo_inertia 0.00027; the bands-off hovers' 0.001175 traded against a low authority), yaw's tilt authority 1 - wash 0.735 (0.30 before), prop_torque -0.0114 and yaw_from_roll 0.0268; and thrust lost with climb along the shafts, climb_inflow 0.03 per m/s (the bursts' vertical specific force: 0.03 for 07:03 and 05:29, 0 for 07:13; weak). Pitch RMS error on the three bursts 32/71/53 -> 20/16/25 deg/s. Why the hover fits had about 1x: within the night's hovers the swings over 4 degrees fit 2.3-2.9x and those under 2 degrees 0.9x, the signature of a regression diluted by the small swings' own error (the servo's and the model's at the 1-degree level); and flown closed loop in sw/sim/flip_firmware.py the quaternion hold shakes at 2.6 Hz with 10 deg/s RMS pitch rate as the drone did (2.35-2.4 Hz, 8-11 deg/s in 2-4 Hz) only on this authority (3 deg/s at 3.1 Hz on the hover fit). The physical cause (a lower CoM or smaller pitch inertia than the CAD's, the slipstream's cancellation fading with tilt) is not pinned: models/NOTES.md 'The bursts' plant'.
